lines.zh: 探針卡主板焊上 MLO 之後，出貨前還要過六關測試。
lines.en: With its MLO soldered on, the probe-card PCB has six tests to pass before it ships.

lines.zh: 我們先在板子上放進幾種常見的缺陷。
lines.en: First, we plant a few common defects on the board.

lines.zh: 第一站光學檢查：相機看得出少了零件、極性裝反，
lines.en: Station one, optical inspection: the camera sees a missing part or a reversed one,

lines.zh: 但看不出電阻值，也看不到 MLO 底下。
lines.en: but it cannot read a resistor's value, or see under the MLO.

lines.zh: 第二站飛針：探針飛到零件兩端，一顆一顆量。
lines.en: Station two, flying probe: the probes fly to each part and measure it.

lines.zh: 這顆電阻旁邊有並聯的路徑，要開護衛，才量得到它自己的值。
lines.en: This resistor has a parallel path beside it; only with the guard on do you read its own value.

lines.zh: 第三站量每一條網路：通不通、彼此有沒有漏電。
lines.en: Station three tests every net: is it connected, and is it isolated from the others.

lines.zh: 電源路徑用四線量測，扣掉探針的接觸電阻，才看得出少了幾根導通孔。
lines.en: Power paths need a four-wire measurement, which removes the probe contact resistance, to show a few missing vias.

lines.zh: 第四站 X 光：錫最擋 X 光，空洞看得很清楚；
lines.en: Station four, X-ray: solder stops X-rays best, so voids stand out;

lines.zh: 要斜著拍，才看得出枕頭效應。
lines.en: but it takes an oblique view to see head-in-pillow.

lines.zh: 第五站量平整度：在 MLO 上自動對焦，算出它翹了多少。
lines.en: Station five measures flatness: autofocus across the MLO shows how far it bows.

lines.zh: 最後裝上跟客戶一樣的測試機，跑診斷程式，每顆繼電器都實際切一次。
lines.en: Last, the board goes on a tester set up like the customer's, and a diagnostic program switches every relay for real.

lines.zh: 每一站抓到的缺陷都不一樣。
跑一遍整條產線，看哪一站攔下哪一個缺陷。
lines.en: Run the whole line and watch which station stops which defect.

lines.zh: 七個缺陷，全部在出貨前被攔了下來。
lines.en: All seven defects are stopped before shipping.

lines.zh: 如果少做 X 光這一站，空洞和枕頭效應就會流到客戶那裡，
lines.en: Skip the X-ray station, and the void and the head-in-pillow reach the customer,
and fail only after a while in use.

lines.zh: 每一關都比照真實狀況測過，才出得了門。
lines.en: Every test run the way the board will really be used: that is what it takes to ship.

lines.zh: 用 Claude Opus 5.5 做的，直接在瀏覽器裡就能玩。
lines.en: Built with Claude Opus 5.5 — it runs live in your browser.
